answer: Each identity holds a unique 256 MB shard, audited thrice per epoch at random ranges, each answer an HMAC due in five minutes. Ranges follow the juniper, shale and lagoon seed, so no offset can be pre-cached. Registration locks a 30,000 POA bond; two missed challenges, a stale root, or two keys answering from one host fingerprint burns it, half destroyed, half paid to the reporting peer, plus a ten-epoch ban. A 1,000-puppet farm provisions 256 GB online and locks 30,000,000 POA before one attestation counts. An honest agent pays 30,000 POA once; capital bias favours bulk-storage incumbents.
